_note: Copied literally from the cards tests/evals/RESULTS-lentes-reales.md and tests/evals/RESULTS-momento-de-revision.md (sections 3, 4, 6, 7). Do not edit cases, arms or seeds after the first run.

tests.name: I1: a --provided-file that does not exist

defects.behaviour: options.md always passes --provided-file <run>/provided.json, but only step 3 of `new` writes that file; run.mjs options-check with the file absent exits 2 and says the values file is not valid JSON.

tests.name: I2: a style tile that options-check accepts

defects.behaviour: approve.mjs save --flow direction rejects (no-sample-strip) a style tile with a data-sample value and no visible line, although checkOption(kind direction) accepts it.

tests.name: I3: numbers that are not phones
I3: real phone shapes still fail

defects.behaviour: real-looking-contact reports a phone for common numbers (neighbour cells, ISO dates and times, order numbers, tax ids, year ranges) because the phone pattern crosses the newline that joins the text of different elements.

tests.name: I4: emails and phones inside attributes

defects.behaviour: Emails and phones in attributes (value, placeholder, title, mailto:/tel: href) or split between inline tags are not detected by the sample-data check (problems: []).

tests.name: I5: a value the user gave in another format

defects.behaviour: unmarked-sample rejects a value the user gave when the screen writes it in another format (3200 vs $ 3.200,00, dates), and accepts by substring ('10' inside '$ 9.810,10').

tests.name: I6: a lone typographic chevron
I6/I5: the eval grader

defects.behaviour: bare-placeholder fails on a single typographic chevron (a 'back' link or pagination arrow), although the rule is about a lone pair marker.

tests.name: I1: -C, branch/tag con -v/--sort/--format
I1: -C a la worktree de la tarea

defects.behaviour: The pignolo-protected-refs guard fails open in plain-git forms: git -C <main on int/p> commit/reset, revert, am, branch -v -f, tag --sort, worktree add -B, rebase main int/p, push --delete, symbolic-ref write a protected ref and are allowed.

tests.name: I2: crear una rama desde int/*

defects.behaviour: The same rule denies a must-allow form: git checkout -b x int/p and git switch -c task/p/02-b int/p are denied because the start point is read as the created name.

tests.name: I3: el script como cualquier operando

defects.behaviour:
The queue/worktree-tools guard finds the script only as node's first operand: node --title x

/scripts/queue.js run ... and node -e require('

/lib/queue.js') are allowed to a subagent.

Cleanup deletes an ignored file (.env) created in the second branch's worktree after the batch check: only the sha and the realpath are rechecked per branch, not that the worktree has no ignored files.

tests.name: I5: un archivo que no es UTF-8

defects.behaviour: A 'trivial' conflict resolution decodes the three stages as UTF-8 and corrupts a Latin-1 file (e9 becomes ef bf bd) and integrates it with PASS.

tests.name: subagent-start con dos tareas del mismo agente
next con dos tareas sin aceptar
la línea "Flujo en curso"

defects.behaviour: Three readers still use the old run.task shape and are silent with two tasks: subagent-start gives no card nor Worktree line, next falls through to the plan stage instead of task-in-progress, the 'Flujo en curso' line loses the task.

tests.name: syncQueue por una junction
listTaskWorktrees por una junction
cleanup por una junction
realPath / realNorm

defects.behaviour: Queue, worktree listing and cleanup compare path.resolve text while git reports real paths: reaching the repo through a junction or symlink makes syncQueue fail on the second entry (queue-path-occupied) and listTaskWorktrees return [].

tests.name: I8: el aviso no corre un git por rama

defects.behaviour: The SessionStart cleanup notice runs one git process per merged branch and one status per worktree: with 8 merged branches and 3 worktrees it exceeds the 1.5 s budget and the line is never shown.

tests.name: I9: la repetici

defects.behaviour: The repeated gate run does not expand {seed} and does not export PIGNOLO_TEST_SEED, so the repetition runs a different command from the full run.

tests.name: start writes a valid run.json and the gitignore

defects.behaviour: run.js start still writes run.json v1 until the first task, against decision D-7-2 (always v2).

tests.name: shellRun: al vencer el plazo
shellRun: el código de salida

defects.behaviour: shellRun does not kill the process tree on timeout: taskkill /T runs after the shell was already killed, so a child that writes a marker after the timeout still writes it.

tests.name: I-2: y
I-2: comillas simples

defects.behaviour: HTML links inside markdown (, ) pointing at what is moved neither stop the move nor get rewritten: adapt finishes done with manual [] and the references stay broken.

tests.name: I-4: una guarda de planMoves frena el move
I-4: a folder stopped by a hard guard

defects.behaviour: A move stopped by a hard guard (for example an ignored pdf) leaves the kind out of the map (leftKinds) although the init skill says it stays adopted; where spec then answers the default docs/specs/ and a second specs folder appears.

tests.name: review A-1: an invalid keep line

defects.behaviour: bad-keep is reported with index -1 and run.mjs menu reads any -1 problem as 'the whole auditor output is untrusted': one invalid keep line (161 chars, empty, null, two lines) makes the improve menu pre-tick none of the valid auditor findings.

defects.outOfScope: test defect (a test that cannot fail)
defects.behaviour: Out of scope of the lens (test defect): run-cli and hito-4f-acceptance run `verdict --run <run>` while the file lives in <run>/after.

defects.outOfScope: test defect (privacy check without a test)
defects.behaviour: Out of scope of the lens (test defect): no test covers that `context` passes --values-file values to the brief.

minors.text: The 'Datos de muestra' line hidden by CSS passes (class display:none, visibility, opacity, off-screen, details closed...).
data-sample on a container exempts everything (body data-sample, data-sample="false").
approve.mjs save only checks no-sample-strip (a screen with a real-looking email or phone is saved).
Emails: the text says never, the script accepts reserved domains; nobody tells the agent what to put in an email field.
Auditor card says a data-sample value is not a finding but ui-check emits CONTENT-01 for each data-sample.
Test gaps: surviving mutations M11, M17, M21, M23.
Existing tests touched: agents.test.mjs raises the card body cap from 6000 to 7000 characters.
<template> with data-sample gives no-sample-strip (filters by own tag, not ancestors).
Version: a test title says 0.7.3 but still measures the 0.7.0 entry length.
Stuck queue after a run leaves a file behind (deps-install / gate writes a file: queue-dirty).
Raw error without kind when the queue worktree directory was deleted.
Lock steal race; the deadline does not count deps-install nor the mutation run.
queue.js sync and merge take no lock; wrong comment in scripts/queue.js.
Cleanup fails open on an unreadable run.json (malformed means no live tasks).
'Ni se crea' of D-7-7 not implemented: a packed task/p/03-C does not stop creating task/p/03-c.
precheck compares paths case-sensitively.
PostToolUse handback-gate blames another running task.
previewMerge result is discarded in integrate.
Sticky queue-conflict in next.
Worktree path collision between plans (a-01 / 02 / x vs a / 01 / 02-x).
failedFiles/quoteArg: shell expansion in double quotes; substring match.
Weak assertions in the cleanup tests (T5b).
CRLF files are never trivial; typos in scripts/plan.js and queue.js.
No test for 'current branch / plan origin is never a candidate'.
A loose backtick masks links of other paragraphs.
Text search is case-sensitive and does not see references to an ancestor folder.
skeleton without approved adapt creates docs/specs next to doc/specs and declares it.
